title: Shortest Delivery Route
statement: A city has n junctions and m two-way roads with travel times. Find the shortest travel time from junction 1 to junction n.
input_format: The first line contains n and m. Each of the next m lines has u, v and w: a road between u and v taking w minutes.
output_format: Print the shortest travel time, or -1 if junction n cannot be reached.

examples.explanation: 1→2→4 takes 10 minutes and 1→3→4 takes 11, so the answer is 10.

hints: All travel times are positive, so a classic single-source shortest path algorithm applies.
Use a priority queue keyed by the current best distance.
Skip queue entries that are older than the best distance already found; totals may exceed 32 bits.
